source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 18 exercise solved (PDF 111-114): MCQs with keys and reasons, genetics problems step by step, model answers for short, long and inquisitive questions, Kitab ki ghalti and Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 18 (Inheritance) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; genetics ke sawal qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain: parents, gametes, Punnett square (table), phir ratio. Short Q15 ke paanch masail aur Q16 ke das joron ka farq alag alag diye gaye hain. Chapter ke andar wale genetic problems topic lessons mein hain, yahan nahi. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi; jawab chapter ke text se nikale gaye hain.
Section 1: Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
1. In the monohybrid cross of Mendel, when a pure round-seeded plant was crossed with a winkled-seeded plant, all the F1 progeny were round-seeded, because of:
(Mendel ke monohybrid cross mein khalis gol beej wale plant ko jhurri-daar beej wale plant se milaya gaya to F1 ke tamam plants gol beej wale the, kyunke:)
blocks.explanation: Gol (R) allele Rr mein poori tarah zahir hota hai aur jhurri wala allele bilkul zahir nahi hota, is liye F1 mein sirf dominant trait aata hai: complete dominance (18.1, 18.3).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "winkled-seeded" chhapa hai; sahi lafz "wrinkled-seeded" (jhurri-daar beej) hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. In a cross of AaBb x AaBb, what fraction of the offspring can be expected to express one of the two dominant alleles, but not both?
(AaBb x AaBb cross mein kitne hisse bachche do dominant alleles mein se sirf ek zahir karenge, dono nahi?)
blocks.explanation: Sirf A dominant (A_bb) = 3/4 × 1/4 = 3/16; sirf B dominant (aaB_) = 1/4 × 3/4 = 3/16. Kul = 3/16 + 3/16 = 6/16 (9:3:3:1 mein dono '3' wale hisse).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Option (c) mein "9/1" chhapa hai; zahir hai yeh 9/16 hona tha (dono dominant traits wala hissa). Har soorat mein yeh jawab nahi.

blocks.prompt:
3. In which of these cases, two genes can experience independent assortment?
(Kis soorat mein do genes independent assortment kar sakte hain?)

options.text: Woh ek hi chromosome par bohat qareeb hon.
Genes ke darmiyan crossing over na ho.
Woh mukhtalif chromosomes par hon ya ek chromosome par door door hon.
Ek gene ka izhar doosre ke izhar par asar na kare.

blocks.explanation: Mukhtalif chromosomes par, ya ek hi chromosome par door door maujood genes azadana assort hote hain; qareeb jure (linked) genes saath rehte hain (18.6.1).

blocks.prompt:
4. The blood group AB may be given to a person who has blood group;
(Blood group AB kis blood group wale ko diya ja sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: AB khoon mein antigen-A aur antigen-B dono hain, is liye sirf woh shakhs le sakta hai jis mein anti-A aur anti-B antibodies na hon, yani AB (18.4.1).

blocks.prompt:
5. If father has blood group B and the mother has blood group A, what blood groups their children have?
(Baap ka blood group B aur maa ka A ho to bachchon ke kaun se blood groups ho sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Agar dono heterozygous hon (baap Iᴮi, maa Iᴬi) to gametes Iᴮ, i × Iᴬ, i se IᴬIᴮ (AB), Iᴮi (B), Iᴬi (A) aur ii (O) bante hain: charon groups mumkin hain.

blocks.prompt:
6. A gene for corn has two alleles, one for yellow kernels and one for white kernels. Cross pollination of yellow corn and white corn results in ears with approximately equal number of yellow and white kernels. Which term best describes the relationship between the two alleles?
(Makai ke ek gene ke do alleles hain, peele aur safed daanon ke. Peeli aur safed makai ki cross pollination se aisi challiyan banti hain jin mein peele aur safed daane taqreeban barabar hain. Dono alleles ka rishta kis istilah se behtar bayan hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Challi mein peela aur safed dono rang saath saath nazar aate hain, mil kar beech ka rang nahi banta, is liye diye gaye options mein kitab ka murad jawab codominance hai (18.3.2); incomplete dominance mein beech ka rang hota, aur crossing over/recombination linked genes ki baat hai. Kitab ki ghalti dekhein: asal mein koi option poori tarah theek nahi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Koi chhapa hua option bilkul theek nahi. Codominance ka matlab hai ke dono alleles aik hi heterozygous fard mein zahir hon (jaise MN blood group, 18.3.2). Yahan har daana (kernel) alag beej yani alag aulad hai, aur peele aur safed daanon ki taqreeban barabar tadaad 1 : 1 ki nisbat hai, jo Yy × yy jaise testcross se aati hai, aam complete dominance ke saath. Crossing over (a) aur recombination (b) linked genes ki baat hain, aur incomplete dominance (c) mein beech ka rang hota. (d) Codominance kitab ka murad jawab maan kar rakha gaya, kyun ke dono rang bina mile saath saath nazar aate hain.

blocks.prompt:
7. A cross between two plants with genotypes AaBb and AaBb results in an F1 generation that is 25% AABB, 50% AaBb, and 25% aabb. Which reason most likely explains why other possible genotypes are not present?
(AaBb aur AaBb ke cross se F1 mein 25% AABB, 50% AaBb aur 25% aabb aate hain. Baqi genotypes na aane ki sab se mumkin wajah kya hai?)

options.text: Genes ke loci bohat qareeb hain.
Genes ke loci mukhtalif chromosomes par hain.
Chromosomes ke darmiyan crossing over hui.

blocks.explanation: Sirf parental combinations (AB aur ab) aaye, jaise ek gene ka 1:2:1, is liye A aur B mukammal linked hain: un ke loci ek hi chromosome par qareeb hain aur crossing over unhein alag nahi karti (18.6.1).

blocks.prompt:
8. In pea plants, the allele for tall stalks (T) is dominant over the allele for short stalks (t). Suppose a cross between a tall pea plant and a short pea plant produces 43 tall offspring and 47 short offspring. If one of the tall offspring is crossed with one of the short offspring, what ratio of genotypes would be most likely in their offspring?
(Matar mein lamba tana (T) chhote tane (t) par dominant hai. Lambe aur chhote plant ke cross se 43 lambe aur 47 chhote bachche hue. Agar ek lamba bachcha ek chhote bachche se milaya jaye to genotypes ka sab se mumkin ratio kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: 43 : 47 taqreeban 1 : 1 hai, yani lamba parent Tt tha (Tt × tt). Is liye lamba bachcha Tt aur chhota tt hai; Tt × tt phir 1 Tt : 1 tt deta hai (testcross, 18.1).

blocks.prompt:
9. Allele B produces black coat colour while b produces white coat colour. Allele C produces curly fur while c produces straight fur. In a cross between two BbCc parents, predict the fraction of offspring with black coat colour and straight fur.
(Allele B kala rang aur b safed rang deta hai. Allele C ghunghrale (curly) baal aur c seedhe baal deta hai. Do BbCc parents ke cross mein kale rang aur seedhe baalon wale bachchon ka hissa kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Hal: kala (B_) = 3/4; seedhe baal (cc) = 1/4; kala aur seedhe baal = 3/4 × 1/4 = 3/16 (product rule, 18.2.2). Sahi jawab 3/16 options mein nahi. Option (b) 9/16 kale aur ghunghrale baalon (B_C_) ka hissa hai, jo kitab ka mumkina maqsood jawab hai; neeche Kitab ki ghalti dekhein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Koi chhapa hua option sahi nahi: kala rang aur seedhe baal (B_cc) = 3/4 × 1/4 = 3/16. Chhape hue hisse doosri qismon ke hain: 1/16 safed aur seedhe baal (bbcc), 9/16 kale aur ghunghrale baal (B_C_), 3/4 tamam kale bachche (B_), aur 16/16 saari aulad. Key (b) 9/16 sirf is liye rakhi gayi ke yeh kitab ka mumkina maqsood jawab hai (dono dominant sifaat wali qism). Imtehan mein hal ke saath 3/16 likhein.

blocks.prompt:
10. What is the criterion to mark an allele as dominant?
(Kisi allele ko dominant qarar dene ka meyaar kya hai?)

options.text: Heterozygous genotype mein allele ka izhar
Allele ki crossing over ki kasrat

blocks.explanation: Allele dominant tab hai jab heterozygote (maslan Rr mein R) mein zahir ho aur doosra allele zahir na ho; aabadi mein kitna aam hai, is se farq nahi parta (18.1).

blocks.prompt:
11. Which of these characters is controlled by a multiple allelic system?
(In mein se kaun si khasoosiyat multiple allelic system se control hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: ABO system ek gene (I) ke teen alleles Iᴬ, Iᴮ aur i se chalta hai (18.3.3); chapter mein Rh system ke do alleles (D, d) aur MN system ke do alleles (Lᴹ, Lᴺ) hain.

blocks.prompt:
12. Albinism is caused by a recessive gene. A woman with albino father marries an albino man. What will be the proportion of her progeny?
(Albinism recessive gene se hota hai. Ek aurat jis ka baap albino hai, ek albino mard se shaadi karti hai. Us ke bachchon ka tanasub kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Aurat khud normal hai magar albino baap (aa) se ek recessive allele mila, is liye woh Aa hai. Aa × aa se gametes A, a × a: 1 Aa (normal) : 1 aa (albino).

blocks.prompt:
13. When the activity of one gene is suppressed by the activity of a non-allelic gene, it is known as;
(Jab ek gene ka asar kisi doosre (non-allelic) gene ke asar se dab jaye to ise kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Epistasis non-allelic interaction hai jis mein ek gene ka allele doosri jagah (locus) ke gene ka asar chhupa ya badal deta hai (18.5.2); baqi options allelic interactions hain.

blocks.prompt:
14. Which of the following is a result of Erythroblastosis fetalis?
(Erythroblastosis fetalis ka natija kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Maa ki anti-Rh antibodies foetus ke RBCs tabah karti hain: anaemia; toote RBCs ka bilirubin jaundice karta hai; zyada bilirubin dimagh ke cells ko nuqsan deta hai (18.4.3).

blocks.prompt:
15. Colour blindness is more common in males because it is a/an;
(Colour blindness mardon mein zyada kyun hai? Kyunke yeh:)
blocks.explanation: Red-green colour blindness X-linked recessive hai: mard mein ek hi X par ek recessive allele kaafi hai, jab ke aurat ko do chahiye (18.8.1).

blocks.prompt:
1. Name the main exceptions to the Mendel’s laws of inheritance.
Mendel ke wirasat ke qawaneen ke bare istisna (exceptions) ke naam likhein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Incomplete dominance aur co-dominance (law of dominance ke istisna).
2. Multiple alleles (do se zyada alleles).
3. Gene linkage aur crossing over (independent assortment ke istisna).
4. Epistasis, polygenic inheritance aur pleiotropy.
5. Sex-linked traits aur mahol (environment) ka asar.

blocks.prompt:
2. What is probability? How does probability relate to genetics?
Probability (imkaan) kya hai? Is ka genetics se kya taluq hai?
blocks.explanation:
Probability yeh hai ke koi natija kitni baar aata hai: waqia hone ki tadaad ÷ kul mumkin natije.
Genes ka agli nasl mein jana ittefaqi (random) hai, is liye bachchon mein har allele combination ka imkaan probability se nikalte hain (azad waqiaat ke liye product rule, ek doosre ko rokne wale waqiaat ke liye sum rule), maslan Aa × Aa: aa = 1/2 × 1/2 = 1/4.

blocks.prompt:
3. Justify that multiple alleles provide many different phenotypes.
Sabit karein ke multiple alleles bohat se mukhtalif phenotypes dete hain.
blocks.explanation: Sirf do alleles se ek gene zyada se zyada teen genotypes deta hai. Multiple alleles se zyada combinations bante hain: ABO gene ke teen alleles (Iᴬ, Iᴮ, i) chhe genotypes dete hain (IᴬIᴬ, Iᴬi, IᴮIᴮ, Iᴮi, IᴬIᴮ, ii). Iᴬ aur Iᴮ co-dominant aur i recessive hone se in se chaar phenotypes (A, B, AB, O) bante hain. Yun multiple alleles tanawwo (variation) barhate hain.

blocks.prompt:
4. Name various human blood group systems.
Insaan ke mukhtalif blood group systems ke naam likhein.
blocks.explanation: International Society of Blood Transfusion 43 blood group systems manti hai. Ahem: ABO system, Rh system, MNS system, Lutheran, Kell, Lewis aur Duffy systems.

blocks.prompt:
5. What do you mean by multiple alleles? Name the alleles responsible for ABO blood group system.
Multiple alleles se kya murad hai? ABO blood group system ke alleles ke naam likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Multiple alleles: aabadi mein kisi gene ki do se zyada shaklein (alleles), agarche har shakhs mein sirf do hoti hain.
ABO alleles: chromosome 9 par gene I ke Iᴬ (antigen-A banata hai), Iᴮ (antigen-B banata hai) aur i (koi antigen nahi).

blocks.prompt:
6. What is co-dominance. Give an example.
Co-dominance kya hai? Misal dein.
blocks.explanation:
Co-dominance: heterozygote mein gene ke dono alleles poori tarah zahir hote hain, na milte hain na ek doosre ko chhupate hain, is liye dono parents ki khususiyaat ek saath nazar aati hain.
Misal: MN blood group; Lᴹ M antigen, Lᴺ N antigen banata hai, aur LᴹLᴺ mein dono (MN group). AB blood group mein Iᴬ aur Iᴮ bhi.

blocks.prompt:
7. What antigens and antibodies are found in ABO blood group system?
ABO blood group system mein kaun se antigens aur antibodies paye jate hain?
blocks.explanation: RBCs par antigens aur plasma mein antibodies (Landsteiner ka qaida: plasma mein us antigen ke khilaf antibody hoti hai jo maujood nahi):

blocks.prompt:
8. Justify why O-negative individuals are called universal donors and AB-positive individuals are called universal recipients.
Sabit karein ke O-negative log universal donor aur AB-positive log universal recipient kyun kehlate hain.
blocks.explanation:
O-negative RBCs par na antigen-A, na antigen-B, na Rh-antigen, is liye kisi lene wale ki antibodies in par hamla nahi kartin: universal donor (har kisi ko dene wala).
AB-positive plasma mein na anti-A, na anti-B, na anti-Rh antibodies, is liye yeh kisi bhi donor ke RBCs par hamla nahi karta: universal recipient (har kisi se lene wala).

blocks.prompt:
9. Why is human male referred as heterogametic?
Insaani mard ko heterogametic kyun kaha jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke us ke sex chromosomes mukhtalif (XY) hain, is liye woh do qisam ke sperms banata hai: aadhe X wale aur aadhe Y wale. Aurat (XX) sirf X wale anday banati hai, is liye homogametic hai.

blocks.prompt:
10. What is gene linkage?
Gene linkage kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Gene linkage genes ka ek hi chromosome par hona hai (linked genes); qareeb jure genes aksar ek saath wirasat mein jate hain aur gametes bante waqt azadana assort nahi hote, maslan Drosophila mein paron ki lambai aur pait ki chaurai.

blocks.prompt:
11. How can the linked gene assort independently?
Linked genes azadana (independently) kaise assort ho sakte hain?
blocks.explanation: Meiosis-I mein crossing over se: homologous chromosomes ke chromatids hisse badalte hain, yun jure hue alleles alag ho kar naye (recombinant) gametes bante hain. Ek chromosome par door door genes mein crossing over itni zyada hoti hai ke woh taqreeban azadana assort hote hain.

blocks.prompt:
12. List at least five polygenic traits in humans.
Insaan ki kam az kam paanch polygenic khususiyaat ki fehrist likhein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Qad (height)
2. Jild ka rang (skin colour)
3. Wazan (weight)
4. Zehanat (intelligence)
5. Aankh ka rang (chapter se bahar)

blocks.prompt:
13. Write brief note on Y-linked inheritance in humans.
Insaan mein Y-linked wirasat par mukhtasar note likhein.
blocks.explanation: Y-linked (holandric) genes sirf Y chromosome ke non-homologous hisse par hote hain aur X par in ke alleles nahi hote. In ki khususiyaat sirf mardon mein aati hain aur baap se tamam beton ko jati hain. Y par genes kam hone se yeh nayaab hain. Misal: hypertrichosis (kaan ke kinare par baal), porcupine man, paon ki ungliyon ka jura hona.

blocks.prompt:
14. Define sex linkage and give an example.
Sex linkage ki tareef karein aur misal dein.
blocks.explanation:
Sex linkage: un khususiyaat ki wirasat jin ke alleles sex chromosomes par hote hain (aam tor par X par, kyunke Y par kaam ke genes taqreeban nahi), is liye mardon aur aurton mein in ka tanasub alag hota hai.
Misal: red-green colour blindness ya haemophilia (X-linked recessive), mardon mein zyada.

blocks.prompt:
15. Solve the following genetic problems:
i. A plant of genotype AABbCC is self-pollinated. Calculate the phenotypic ratio of F2 generation.
AABbCC genotype wala plant self-pollinate hota hai. Aglay nasl (F2) ka phenotypic ratio nikalein.
blocks.explanation:
Parents: AABbCC × AABbCC
AA aur CC homozygous hain, is liye sirf Bb alag hota hai.
Gametes: har parent se ABC aur AbC.
Bachche: 1 AABBCC : 2 AABbCC : 1 AAbbCC
Phenotypes: AABBCC aur AABbCC mein dominant B trait; AAbbCC mein recessive b.
Phenotypic ratio = 3 : 1

blocks.prompt:
15. Solve the following genetic problems:
ii. In four-o’clock plant, the red and white flower colours show incomplete dominance. Calculate the ratios in crosses between (i) two red-flowered plants; (ii) a red-flowered and a pink-flowered plant; (iii) a pink-flowered and a white-flowered.
Four-o'clock plant mein laal aur safed phool incomplete dominance dikhate hain. In crosses ke ratios nikalein: (i) do laal phool wale; (ii) laal aur gulabi (pink); (iii) gulabi aur safed.
blocks.explanation:
Alleles: R (laal), W (safed); RR = laal, RW = gulabi, WW = safed.
(i) Laal × laal: RR × RR; gametes R × R; sab RR: sab laal.
(ii) Laal × gulabi: RR × RW; gametes R × R, W; 1 RR : 1 RW: 1 laal : 1 gulabi.
(iii) Gulabi × safed: RW × WW; gametes R, W × W; 1 RW : 1 WW: 1 gulabi : 1 safed.

blocks.prompt:
15. Solve the following genetic problems:
iii. A man with blood group A marries a woman who has blood group AB. What blood groups are expected among their children?
Blood group A wala mard blood group AB wali aurat se shaadi karta hai. Bachchon ke kaun se blood groups ho sakte hain?
blocks.explanation:
Aurat AB = IᴬIᴮ; gametes Iᴬ, Iᴮ.
Mard A, IᴬIᴬ ya Iᴬi ho sakta hai.
Soorat 1: IᴬIᴬ × IᴬIᴮ → IᴬIᴬ, IᴬIᴮ: blood groups A aur AB (1 : 1).
Soorat 2: Iᴬi × IᴬIᴮ → IᴬIᴬ, IᴬIᴮ, Iᴬi, Iᴮi: A : AB : B = 2 : 1 : 1.
Yani bachche A, AB ya B ho sakte hain; O kabhi nahi.

blocks.prompt:
15. Solve the following genetic problems:
iv. Two white sheep produce a black offspring. What are the parents’ genotypes for the colour? What is the probability that their next offspring will be black?
Do safed bheron se kala bachcha paida hua. Parents ke genotypes kya hain? Agla bachcha kala hone ka imkaan kitna hai?
blocks.explanation:
Do safed parents se kala bachcha yani safed dominant (W) aur kala recessive (w) hai; kala bachcha ww hai, is liye har parent ne ek w diya.
Parents ke genotypes: Ww × Ww (dono heterozygous).
Gametes: W, w × W, w.
Bachche: 1 WW : 2 Ww : 1 ww (3 safed : 1 kala).
Agla bachcha kala hone ka imkaan = 1/4 (25%).

blocks.prompt:
15. Solve the following genetic problems:
v. Albinism (lack of pigment) in man is caused by a recessive gene. If normal parents have an albino child, what is the probability that their next child will be normal for colour?
Insaan mein albinism (rang ki kami) recessive gene se hota hai. Agar normal parents ka albino bachcha ho to agla bachcha normal hone ka imkaan kitna hai?
blocks.explanation:
Albino bachcha aa hai, is liye dono normal parents mein a hai: parents Aa × Aa.
Gametes: A, a × A, a.
Bachche: 1 AA : 2 Aa : 1 aa (3 normal : 1 albino).
Agla bachcha normal hone ka imkaan = 3/4 (75%).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Har genetics problem ka tareeqa: (1) alleles ke nishan likhein, (2) parents ke genotypes, (3) gametes, (4) Punnett square, (5) genotypes aur phenotypes gin kar ratio ya imkaan (probability). Har ek nayi paidaish ka imkaan pichhle bachchon se azad hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
16. Differentiate between:
• Gene and allele
Gene aur allele mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Ek gene ki mukhtalif shaklein alleles kehlati hain.

rows: DNA ke nucleotides ka silsila jo polypeptide banata hai; khasoosiyat ki ikaai
Gene ki mutabadil shakal jo mutabadil khasoosiyat deti hai
Homologous chromosomes par ek hi locus par
Misal: beej ki shakal ka gene

blocks.prompt:
16. Differentiate between:
• Genotype and phenotype
Genotype aur phenotype mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Genotype naqsha hai aur phenotype nazar aane wala natija.

rows: Kisi fard mein alleles ka majmooa
Nazar nahi aata; crosses (testcross) se maloom hota hai
Nazar aata hai; mahol ka asar bhi

blocks.prompt:
16. Differentiate between:
• Homozygous and heterozygous
Homozygous aur heterozygous mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Dono kisi fard ke gene jore ko bayan karte hain.

rows: Gene jore ke dono alleles ek jaise
Ek jaise allele wale gametes ke milap se
Mukhtalif allele wale gametes ke milap se
Khalis nasl (pure-breeding); ek qisam ke gametes
Khalis nahi; do qisam ke gametes

blocks.prompt:
16. Differentiate between:
• Monohybrid and dihybrid cross
Monohybrid aur dihybrid cross mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Farq ek saath dekhi gayi khususiyaat ki tadaad ka hai.

rows: Ek khasoosiyat (ek gene jora) ki wirasat
Do khususiyaat (do gene jore) ki ek saath wirasat
Misal: RrYy × RrYy (beej ki shakal aur rang)
Law of independent assortment ki bunyad

blocks.prompt:
16. Differentiate between:
• Incomplete dominance and co-dominance
Incomplete dominance aur co-dominance mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Dono mein heterozygote mein koi allele doosre ko nahi chhupata.

rows: Dono alleles ke asar mil jate hain
Heterozygote mein dono parents ki khususiyaat ek saath
Misal: four o'clock ka gulabi (RW) phool
Misal: MN aur AB blood groups

blocks.prompt:
16. Differentiate between:
• Epistasis and polygenic inheritance
Epistasis aur polygenic inheritance mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Dono mein ek se zyada genes hain, magar kaam ka tareeqa alag hai.

rows: Ek gene ka allele doosre gene ka asar chhupata/badalta hai
Bohat se genes apna thora thora asar jorte hain
Aam tor par alag alag qismein (discontinuous)
Misal: gandum ke daane ka rang, jild ka rang, qad

blocks.prompt:
16. Differentiate between:
• XX-XY and ZZ-ZW sex determination
XX-XY aur ZZ-ZW sex determination mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Dono chromosome wale nizam hain; heterogametic jins (sex) alag hai.

rows: Sperm bachche ki jins tay karta hai
Anda bachche ki jins tay karta hai

blocks.prompt:
16. Differentiate between:
• XX-XY and XX-ZO sex determination
XX-XY aur XX-XO sex determination mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Dono mein mada XX hai; nar alag hai.

rows: Nar XO: Y nahi, sirf ek X
Nar aur mada ke chromosomes barabar
Nar mein ek chromosome kam (tiddi: nar 23, mada 24)
Sperms mein X ya koi sex chromosome nahi (nullo gamete)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Jore mein "XX-ZO" chhapa hai; sahi "XX-XO" hai (tiddi ka nizam, jis mein nar mein ek X aur Y nahi).

blocks.prompt:
16. Differentiate between:
• Sex-linked and sex-limited traits
Sex-linked aur sex-limited traits mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Dono ka tanasub nar aur mada mein alag hai, magar wajah alag hai.

rows: Genes sex chromosomes (zyada tar X) par
Genes autosomes par, dono jinson mein maujood
Dono jinson mein, magar mukhtalif tanasub mein
Sirf ek jins mein zahir (jismani banawat ya hormones ki wajah se)
Misal: mardon ki daarhi, mada mein doodh, nar bher ke seeng

blocks.prompt:
16. Differentiate between:
• Sex-limited and sex-influenced traits
Sex-limited aur sex-influenced traits mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Dono autosomal khususiyaat hain jin ka izhar jins par munhasir hai.

rows: Dono jinson mein, mukhtalif andaz se
Jismani banawat ya hormones ke farq se
Allele ek jins mein dominant, doosre mein recessive (hormones)
Misal: daarhi, doodh banna, ovarian cancer

blocks.prompt:
1. Explain Mendel’s experiment which led to the formulation of the law independent assortment.
Mendel ka woh tajurba bayan karein jis se law of independent assortment bana.
blocks.explanation:
Mendel ne matar ki do khususiyaat ek saath dekhin: beej ki shakal (gol R dominant, jhurri-daar r recessive) aur beej ka rang (peela Y dominant, hara y recessive).
P: khalis gol peela (RRYY) × jhurri-daar hara (rryy).
Gametes: RY × ry.
F1: sab RrYy, gol aur peele (dihybrids).
F1 ki self-fertilization: har F1 plant chaar qisam ke gametes barabar banata hai: RY, Ry, rY, ry. 4 nar × 4 mada gametes se 16 combinations.
F2 phenotypes: 9 gol peele : 3 gol hare : 3 jhurri peele : 1 jhurri hara.
Har jora phir bhi 3 : 1 raha (12 gol : 4 jhurri; 12 peele : 4 hare), yani shakal rang se azad wirasat mein gayi aur naye combinations (gol hara, jhurri peela) bane.
Law of independent assortment: 'gametes bante waqt har allele jora doosre joron se azad (independently) alag hota hai.' Jadeed shakal: mukhtalif chromosomes par genes meiosis mein azadana assort hote hain, kyunke homologous jore ittefaqan qatar banate hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "the law independent assortment" chhapa hai; sahi "the law of independent assortment" hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. Explain incomplete dominance and exemplify it through the inheritance of flower colour in 4 O’ clock plant.
Incomplete dominance ki wazahat karein aur 4 O' clock plant ke phool ke rang ki wirasat se misal dein.
blocks.explanation:
Incomplete dominance: koi allele poori tarah dominant nahi; heterozygote dono parents ke darmiyan ki (intermediate) khasoosiyat dikhata hai (asar mil jate hain).
Misal, Japani four o'clock plant (Mirabilis jalapa):
P: laal (RR) × safed (WW)
Gametes: R × W
F1: sab RW, gulabi phool (na laal na safed).
F1 × F1: RW × RW; gametes R, W × R, W.
F2: 1 RR (laal) : 2 RW (gulabi) : 1 WW (safed).
Yahan genotypic aur phenotypic ratio ek jaise (1 : 2 : 1) hain, Mendel ke 3 : 1 ke bar-aks, kyunke heterozygote pehchana jata hai. Alleles hamesha ke liye nahi milte: F2 mein laal aur safed dobara aa jate hain.

blocks.prompt:
3. Explain Erythroblastosis foetalis in the light of antigen-antibody reaction. What measures can be taken to prevent Erythroblastosis foetalis?
Erythroblastosis foetalis ko antigen-antibody reaction ki roshni mein bayan karein. Is se bachao ke liye kya iqdamat kiye ja sakte hain?
blocks.explanation:
Erythroblastosis foetalis Rh ke na-milap (incompatibility) se hone wali foetus/naumolood ki khoon-tor (haemolytic) bimari hai.
Antigen-antibody reaction:
1. Yeh tab hoti hai jab Rh-negative maa (dd) ke pait mein Rh-positive bachcha (Dd) ho, D allele Rh-positive baap se.
2. Bachche ka khoon (Rh-antigen wala) maa ke khoon mein aa sakta hai, khaas kar paidaish ke waqt. Rh-negative logon mein qudrati anti-Rh antibodies nahi hotin, is liye maa ka immune system hassas (sensitized) ho kar anti-Rh antibodies banata hai jo umar bhar rehti hain.
3. Aam tor par pehla bachcha bach jata hai, magar agle Rh-positive hamal mein yeh antibodies placenta se guzar kar foetus ke khoon mein jati hain aur us ke RBCs ke Rh-antigen se reaction kar ke unhein tabah karti hain.
Natije: haemolytic anaemia; liver aur spleen bare (zyada RBCs banane ki koshish); toote RBCs ka bilirubin jaundice karta aur dimagh ke cells ko nuqsan deta hai; shadeed soorat mein hamal zaya ya murda paidaish.
Bachao aur ilaaj:
1. Rh-negative maa ko hamal ke shuru mein aur paidaish ke foran baad Rh-antiserum (anti-Rh antibodies) ka injection; yeh maa ke khoon mein aaye bachche ke RBCs ko us ke immune system ke hassas hone se pehle khatam kar deta hai.
2. Maa (aur baap) ka Rh group pehle hi check karna taa ke khatre wala hamal maloom ho.
3. Mutasir naumolood ka khoon Rh-negative khoon se badla jata hai jis mein anti-Rh antibodies na hon.
4. ABO na-milap (maslan O-negative maa, A ya B-positive bachcha) qudrati hifazat deta hai, kyunke maa ki anti-A ya anti-B pehle hi bachche ke RBCs khatam kar deti hain.

blocks.prompt:
4. Describe polygenic inheritance, using an example from grain colour in wheat.
Polygenic inheritance ko gandum ke daane ke rang ki misal se bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Polygenic inheritance: aisi khasoosiyat jo bohat se gene joron se control ho aur un ke alleles apna asar jorte (additive) hon; mila jula asar ek khasoosiyat deta hai jis mein musalsal tanawwo (continuous variation) hota hai, maslan qad, jild ka rang, wazan, zehanat.
Gandum ke daane ka rang (safed se gehra laal) teen polygenes A, B, C se control hota hai. Har dominant allele (A, B, C) laal rang jorta hai; recessive alleles (a, b, c) kuch nahi. Rang dominant alleles ki ginti par munhasir hai.
P: gehra laal (AABBCC) × safed (aabbcc)
F1: AaBbCc, darmiyana laal.
F1 × F1: har parent 8 qisam ke gametes banata hai, F2 mein 64 combinations.
F2: 1 gehra laal (6 dominant alleles) : 6 : 15 : 20 (darmiyana, 3 dominant) : 15 : 6 : 1 safed (0 dominant). 64 mein sirf ek gehra laal (AABBCC) aur ek safed (aabbcc); baqi 62 laal ke mukhtalif rang.
Yeh bohat si qismein musalsal silsila (ghante jaisa curve) banati hain; mahol (roshni, pani, ghiza) bhi rang par asar karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
5. Explain epistasis with the help of an example.
Epistasis ko misal ki madad se bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Epistasis non-allelic gene interaction hai jis mein ek gene ka allele doosri jagah (locus) ke gene ke alleles ka asar chhupa (mask) ya badal deta hai. Chhupane wala allele epistatic aur chhupne wala hypostatic kehlata hai. Is se mutawaqqa 9:3:3:1 ratio badal jata hai.
Misal, Labrador kutton ka rang (do genes):
1. Gene B rang (pigment) tay karta hai: B (kala) b (bhoora) par dominant.
2. Gene E baalon mein pigment jamne ko control karta hai: E jamne deta hai; ee rok deta hai, is liye rang peela hota hai chahe B ho ya b (e, B/b par epistatic hai).
Cross: do heterozygous kale kutte BbEe × BbEe.
Natija: 9 B_E_ kale : 3 bbE_ bhoore : 3 B_ee peele + 1 bbee peela = 4 peele.
Ratio 9 : 3 : 4, 9 : 3 : 3 : 1 ke bajaye.
Doosri misalein: foxglove ke phool (dominant W rang ko nuqton tak mehdood karta hai, DdWw self karne par 12 safed : 3 gehre laal : 1 halka laal); Bombay phenotype (hh se A aur B antigens nahi bante, shakhs O jaisa test hota hai).

blocks.prompt:
6. Explain how gene linkage counters independent assortment and crossing-over modifies the progeny.
Wazahat karein ke gene linkage independent assortment ka mukhalif kaise hai aur crossing over bachchon (progeny) ko kaise badalti hai.
blocks.explanation:
Gene linkage independent assortment ke khilaf:
1. Hazaron genes mehdood chromosomes par hain (insaan mein taqreeban 20,000 genes 23 joron par), is liye har chromosome par bohat se genes qatar mein hain.
2. Ek hi chromosome ke genes (linked genes) aksar saath wirasat mein jate hain; azadana assort nahi hote. Is liye dihybrid chaar qisam ke gametes barabar nahi banata; parental combinations zyada hote hain.
3. Pehchan: agar cross mein parental aur naye combinations 1:1:1:1 mein hon to genes linked nahi; parental zyada aur naye kam hon to incomplete linkage; sirf parental hon to complete linkage (maslan Morgan ki Drosophila, F2 mein 9 : 3 : 3 : 1 ke bajaye 3 : 1).
Crossing over progeny ko badalti hai:
1. Meiosis-I mein homologous chromosomes ke chromatids saath lag kar hisse badalte hain; DNA toot kar dobara judta hai.
2. Genes ki tarteeb wahi rehti hai magar alleles nayi tarteeb mein aa jate hain, jure alleles alag ho jate hain.
3. Recombinant chromatids mukhtalif gametes mein jate hain aur bachchon mein parental ke ilawa naye combinations (recombinants) bante hain.
4. Yun crossing over linkage torti, incomplete linkage banati aur genetic tanawwo ka zariya hai; door door genes mein zyada crossing over hoti hai aur woh taqreeban azad assort hote hain.

blocks.prompt:
7. Exemplify the concept of gene linkage by quoting the example of wing length and width of abdomen in Drosophila melanogaster.
Drosophila melanogaster mein paron ki lambai aur pait ki chaurai ki misal se gene linkage ka tasawwur wazeh karein.
blocks.explanation:
Thomas Hunt Morgan ne Drosophila mein do khususiyaat dekhin: paron ki lambai (lambe L, chhote/vestigial l par dominant) aur pait ki chaurai (chaura B, patla b par dominant).
P: lambe par, chaura pait (LLBB) × vestigial par, patla pait (llbb).
F1: sab lambe par, chaura pait (LlBb; L aur B ek chromosome par, l aur b us ke homologue par).
F1 × F1: independent assortment se F2 mein 9 lambe-chaure : 3 lambe-patle : 3 vestigial-chaure : 1 vestigial-patla hone chahiye the (3 : 3 wale naye combinations).
Asal F2: sirf parental combinations, 3/4 lambe par-chaura pait aur 1/4 vestigial par-patla pait; koi naya combination nahi.
Nateeja: paron ki lambai aur pait ki chaurai ke genes ek hi chromosome par qareeb hain aur azadana assort nahi hote; har F1 sirf LB aur lb gametes banata hai, is liye ek gene jaisa 3 : 1 aaya. Yeh complete linkage hai.

blocks.prompt:
8. Explain the XX-XY mechanism of sex determination in Drosophila and mammals.
Drosophila aur mammals mein jins (sex) tay karne ka XX-XY tareeqa bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Drosophila, mammals aur aksar vertebrates mein jins sex chromosomes ka jora tay karta hai: dande (rod) jaisa X aur kaante (hook) jaisa Y.
Karyotype: Drosophila mein 3 jore autosomes + 1 jora sex chromosomes (mada 6 + XX, nar 6 + XY); insaan mein 22 jore autosomes + 1 jora sex chromosomes (aurat 44 + XX, mard 44 + XY).
Tareeqa:
1. Mada (XX) homogametic hai: tamam anday ek X wale.
2. Nar (XY) heterogametic hai: aadhe sperms X wale aur aadhe Y wale.
3. X-sperm + anda → XX zygote → mada; Y-sperm + anda → XY zygote → nar.
4. Yani sperm jins tay karta hai aur nar aur mada 1 : 1 mein paida hote hain.
Insaan mein Y chromosome ka SRY gene aisa protein banata hai jo testes ki nashonuma shuru karta aur mada ke aaza ko rokta hai.

blocks.prompt:
9. Describe the XX-XO and ZZ-ZW sex determination systems and evaluate by studying the karyotype.
XX-XO aur ZZ-ZW jins tay karne ke nizam bayan karein aur karyotype ke mutale se jaiza lein.
blocks.explanation:
Karyotype chromosomes ke poore set ki tadaad, size aur shakal hai; sex chromosomes ke ilawa tamam jore dono jinson mein ek jaise hote hain.
1. XX-XO nizam (kuch keeray, maslan tiddi/grasshopper):
Karyotype: dono jinson mein 22 autosomes (11 jore). Mada XX: 24 chromosomes. Nar mein sirf ek X aur Y nahi (XO): 23 chromosomes.
Gametes: tamam anday X wale; nar do qisam ke sperm banata hai, aadhe X wale aur aadhe baghair sex chromosome (nullo gamete).
X-sperm + anda → XX mada; nullo sperm + anda → XO nar. Nar heterogametic hai aur sperm jins tay karta hai.
2. ZZ-ZW nizam (parinde):
Karyotype: autosomes ki tadaad parindon mein alag; mada ZW aur nar ZZ.
Gametes: mada heterogametic hai, aadhe Z wale aur aadhe W wale anday; tamam sperms Z wale.
Z-anda + sperm → ZZ nar; W-anda + sperm → ZW mada. Yahan anda jins tay karta hai.
Karyotype se jaiza: XX-XO mein dono jinson ke chromosomes ki tadaad alag hai (24 aur 23); ZZ-ZW mein tadaad barabar hai magar mada ka sex jora na-barabar (Z aur W) aur nar ka ek jaisa (ZZ) hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Chapter (Systems of Sex Determination) mein ek jagah "a Y carrying egg" chhapa hai; parindon mein Y nahi hota, sahi "W carrying egg" hai. Imtehan mein W hi likhein.

blocks.prompt:
10. Explain the inheritance of a sex-linked trait in Drosophila.
Drosophila mein kisi sex-linked khasoosiyat ki wirasat bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
1910 mein T. H. Morgan ko laal aankhon wali makhiyon mein ek safed aankh wala nar Drosophila mila. Farz karein Xᴿ = laal (dominant) aur Xʳ = safed (recessive), X chromosome par; Y par allele nahi.
1. Safed aankh nar (XʳY) × laal aankh mada (XᴿXᴿ) → F1 sab laal (XᴿXʳ mada, XᴿY nar): laal dominant hai.
2. F1 × F1 (XᴿXʳ × XᴿY) → F2 taqreeban 3 laal : 1 safed, magar tamam safed aankh wale nar the (XʳY); madayein XᴿXᴿ ya XᴿXʳ, sab laal.
3. Testcross F1 laal mada (XᴿXʳ) × safed nar (XʳY) → laal mada, safed mada, laal nar, safed nar 1 : 1 : 1 : 1, yani safed aankh wali mada mumkin hai.
4. Safed aankh mada (XʳXʳ) × laal aankh nar (XᴿY) → tamam mada laal (XᴿXʳ), tamam nar safed (XʳY) (criss-cross wirasat).
Nateeja: aankh ke rang ka gene X chromosome par hai aur Y par is ka allele nahi; aise genes aur khususiyaat sex-linked hain. Nar mein recessive X-linked khasoosiyat ek allele se hi zahir hoti hai, aur nar ko X maa se milta hai.

blocks.prompt:
11. Describe sex-influenced and sex-limited traits with common examples from human genetics.
Insaani genetics ki aam misalon se sex-influenced aur sex-limited khususiyaat bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Dono autosomal khususiyaat hain (genes sex chromosomes par nahi) jin ka tanasub mardon aur aurton mein alag hai.
1. Sex-limited: genes dono jinson mein maujood magar sirf ek mein zahir, jismani banawat ya hormones ke farq se. Misal: mardon mein daarhi; aurton mein doodh banna; prostate cancer sirf mardon aur ovarian cancer sirf aurton mein. (Janwaron mein: nar bher ke seeng.) Sex-limited genes nar aur mada ki zahiri farq (sexual dimorphism) ki wajah hain.
2. Sex-influenced: wahi gene dono jinson mein magar mukhtalif andaz se zahir; allele ek jins mein dominant aur doosre mein recessive, hormones ki wajah se. Misal: ganjapan (baldness) aur jism ke baalon ki miqdar. Ganjepan ka allele mardon mein dominant aur aurton mein recessive hai: mard ek ya do baldness alleles se ganja hota hai (homozygous ya heterozygous), jab ke aurat sirf do baldness alleles se. Is liye ganjapan mardon mein kahin zyada hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Chapter ke text mein likha hai ke aurat "bb" ho to ganji hogi; agar B ganjepan ka allele ho to sahi yeh hai ke aurat sirf BB (do ganjepan wale alleles) par ganji hoti hai. Imtehan mein "do baldness alleles" likhein.

blocks.prompt:
12. Write a note on the inheritance of haemophilia in humans.
Insaan mein haemophilia ki wirasat par note likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Haemophilia nayaab bimari hai jis mein chot ke baad khoon theek se nahi jamta, kyunke khoon jamane wale factors kam, kharab ya ghaib hote hain. Qismein:
1. Haemophilia A: factor VIII kharab; X-linked recessive.
2. Haemophilia B: factor IX kharab; X-linked recessive.
3. Haemophilia C: factor XI kharab; autosomal recessive, dono jinson mein barabar.
A aur B ki wirasat (Xᴴ = normal, Xʰ = haemophilia):
1. Mard mein ek Xʰ kaafi hai (XʰY), kyunke Y par allele nahi; aurat ko XʰXʰ hona chahiye, is liye mardon mein kahin zyada. Heterozygous aurat (XᴴXʰ) normal carrier (haamil) hai.
2. Carrier maa × normal baap (XᴴXʰ × XᴴY): betiyan 1/2 normal, 1/2 carrier; bete 1/2 normal, 1/2 haemophiliac.
3. Haemophiliac baap × normal maa (XᴴXᴴ × XʰY): tamam betiyan carrier, tamam bete normal (beta baap ka X nahi leta).
4. Do normal parents ka haemophiliac beta sirf tab ho sakta hai jab maa carrier ho.

blocks.prompt:
13. Write a note on the inheritance of colour blindness in humans.
Insaan mein colour blindness ki wirasat par note likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Normal (trichromatic) nazar retina ke teen qisam ke cones se hoti hai: laal, hare aur neele ke liye hassas, har ek ka apna pigment protein (opsin). Laal aur hare opsins ke genes X chromosome par aur neele opsin ka gene autosome 7 par hai. Recessive opsin alleles colour blindness karte hain:
1. Dichromacy: do rang nazar aate hain, teesra nahi: laal-andhapan (protanopia), hara-andhapan (deuteranopia), neela-andhapan (tritanopia).
2. Monochromacy (mukammal colour blindness): sirf ek rang; nayaab.
Red-green colour blindness ki wirasat (X-linked recessive; Xᴺ = normal, Xⁿ = colour-blind):
1. Mard mein ek Xⁿ kaafi (XⁿY); aurat ko XⁿXⁿ chahiye, is liye mardon mein zyada. XᴺXⁿ aurat carrier hai, nazar normal.
2. Carrier maa × normal baap: 1/2 bete colour-blind; 1/2 betiyan carrier.
3. Colour-blind baap × normal maa: tamam betiyan carrier, tamam bete normal.
4. Colour-blind maa: us ke tamam bete colour-blind.
Ilaaj nahi; colour-blind ainak, khaas software aur rang pehchanne ki mashq madad karti hai.

blocks.prompt:
14. Explain Morgan’s experiment to explain crossing over and gene linkage.
Crossing over aur gene linkage samjhane ke liye Morgan ka tajurba bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Gene linkage (Morgan ka tajurba): Morgan ne lambe par aur chaure pait wali Drosophila (LLBB) ko vestigial par aur patle pait wali makhiyon (llbb) se milaya. F1 sab lambe-chaure (LlBb). Independent assortment se F1 × F1 ko 9 : 3 : 3 : 1 dena tha, magar sirf parental combinations aaye, 3 lambe-chaure : 1 vestigial-patla. Nateeja: dono genes ek hi chromosome par hain aur saath wirasat mein jate hain (linkage); L aur B ek homologue par, l aur b doosre par.
Crossing over: meiosis-I mein homologous chromosomes ke chromatids saath lag kar hisse badalte hain; DNA toot kar dobara judta hai. Agar do linked genes (maslan L aur B) ke darmiyan crossing over ho to alleles naye combinations (Lb aur lB) mein aa jate hain, aur parental ke saath thore se recombinant bachche (lambe par-patla pait, vestigial par-chaura pait) bante hain (incomplete linkage). Recombinants jitne kam, genes utne qareeb (chapter se bahar: recombination frequency se genes ka naqsha banaya jata hai). Yun linkage genes ko saath rakhta hai aur crossing over linkage tor kar tanawwo paida karti hai.

blocks.prompt:
1. Collect data from the class or the college to see how many individuals have AB blood group and construct a pie chart and histogram for the collected data.
Class ya college se data jama karein ke kitne logon ka blood group AB hai aur is data ka pie chart aur histogram banayein.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh amli kaam (activity) hai; jawab aap ka apna data hoga. Tareeqa:
1. Har talib ilm se us ka ABO aur Rh blood group (test ya card se) poochein aur tally table mein likhein: A, B, AB, O (aur positive/negative).
2. Kul tadaad aur har group ginein; group ka percentage = (group ki tadaad ÷ kul) × 100.
3. Pie chart: har hisse ka zaviya = (group ki tadaad ÷ kul) × 360°; A, B, AB aur O ke hisse bana kar percentage likhein.
4. Histogram (bar graph): x-axis par blood groups aur y-axis par talaba ki tadaad; har group ka bar banayein.
5. Nateeja: AB aam tor par sab se chhota group hota hai, kyunke is ke liye Iᴬ aur Iᴮ dono alleles chahiye, jab ke recessive i allele aam hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. Use a dice to calculate how many times out of 100 throws can you get sixes.
Dice (paansa) istemal kar ke hisaab lagayein ke 100 dafa phenkne mein kitni dafa chhakka (six) aa sakta hai.
blocks.explanation:
Ek dafa mein chhakke ka imkaan = 1 (ek rukh) ÷ 6 (mumkin natije) = 1/6.
100 dafa mein mutawaqqa chhakke = 100 × 1/6 ≈ 16.7, yani taqreeban 17.
Paansa 100 dafa phenk kar chhakke ginein; asal tadaad 17 ke qareeb hogi magar badal sakti hai, aur jitni zyada dafa phenkein utna 1/6 ke qareeb aati hai. Isi tarah genetic ratios (3 : 1, 1 : 1) imkaanaat hain jo sirf zyada bachchon mein saaf nazar aate hain.

blocks.prompt:
3. Derive an idea to get alternatives of blood transfusion. (reference could be made to synthesized plasma and serum).
Blood transfusion ke mutabadil (alternatives) ka khayal pesh karein (banawati plasma aur serum ka hawala de sakte hain).
blocks.explanation:
(Chapter se bahar.) Khoon ki zaroorat miqdar poori karne, oxygen le jane aur jamne ke liye hoti hai. Mutabadil:
1. Plasma ke badal (volume expanders): saline, Ringer's solution, albumin, dextran ya banawati colloid mahlool khoon zaya hone ke baad miqdar aur pressure bahal karte hain; banawati plasma aur serum proteins (maslan albumin, haemophilia ke liye factor VIII jaise clotting factors) khaas hisse poore karte hain.
2. Masnooi oxygen carriers: haemoglobin wale mahlool aur perfluorocarbons jo RBCs ke baghair oxygen le jate hain aur ABO/Rh milane ki zaroorat nahi.
3. Mareez ka apna khoon banwana: erythropoietin, iron aur vitamins.
4. Mareez ka apna khoon: operation se pehle jama kar lena (autologous transfusion) aur operation mein beh jane wale khoon ko wapas istemal (cell salvage).
5. Lab mein stem cells se RBCs banana (tehqeeq jari).
Yeh mutabadil matching ke masail, transfusion reactions aur infection se bachate hain.

blocks.prompt:
4. Justify why a recessive blood group allele of ‘i’ is more frequent in population.
Sabit karein ke recessive blood group allele 'i' aabadi mein zyada kyun hai.
blocks.explanation:
Allele i AB ke ilawa har blood group se aage jata hai, aur carriers (Iᴬi, Iᴮi) mein chhupa rehta hai, is liye khatam nahi hota:
1. O (ii) × O (ii): sab bachche O (ii).
2. Iᴬi × Iᴬi: 25% bachche O (ii).
3. Iᴮi × Iᴮi: 25% bachche O (ii).
4. Iᴬi × Iᴮi: 25% bachche O (ii).
Yun i allele har nasl mein dobara zahir hota rehta hai, is liye yeh sab se aam ABO allele aur O aam blood group hai.

blocks.prompt:
5. Justify blood donation as a service to suffering humanity.
Khoon ke atiye (blood donation) ko dukhi insaniyat ki khidmat sabit karein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Khoon factory mein nahi banta; mareez donors par munhasir hain.
2. Atiya kiya khoon hadsaat, operations, zachgi mein zyada khoon behne aur anaemia mein jaanein bachata hai.
3. Thalassaemia aur haemophilia ke mareezon ko baqaidagi se khoon ya us ke ajza chahiye; erythroblastosis foetalis wale naumolood ko Rh-negative khoon chahiye.
4. Ek atiya RBCs, plasma aur platelets mein alag ho kar kai mareezon ke kaam aata hai; O-negative khoon (universal donor) emergency mein qeemti hai.
5. Sehatmand donor ke liye mehfooz hai; jism jald khoon poora kar leta hai (chapter se bahar). Dene wale ka nuqsan kam aur doosre ko zindagi milti hai, is liye yeh insaniyat ki sachi khidmat hai.

blocks.prompt:
6. Suggest ways to save lives through the knowledge gained in this chapter.
Is chapter ke ilm se jaanein bachane ke tareeqe tajweez karein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Blood transfusion: donor aur mareez ke ABO aur Rh groups milayein taa ke khoon na jame (agglutination); emergency mein O-negative.
2. Erythroblastosis foetalis se bachao: maaon ka Rh group test; Rh-negative maa ko hamal aur paidaish ke baad Rh-antiserum; mutasir bachche ka khoon badalna.
3. Haemophilia, colour blindness, muscular dystrophy, albinism wale khandanon ke liye genetic mashwara (counselling): shajra (pedigree) aur Punnett square se khatra jaanchna; carriers ki pehchan.
4. Embryonic screening (ultrasound, chorionic villus sampling, amniocentesis) se genetic bimariyan aur chromosomes ki ghalat tadaad jald maloom karna.
5. Genetic bimariyon ki jald dekh-bhaal: haemophilia mein clotting factor ka ilaaj, muscular dystrophy mein physical therapy aur dawaiyan.
6. Qareebi rishtedaron mein shaadi se parhez recessive bimariyan kam karta hai (chapter se bahar).
7. Baqaidagi se razakarana khoon ka atiya.
